title: EmbeddingJob
description: Declarative job record for embedding approved knowledge chunks, with profile provenance and invalidations. Vectors are indexes, never a system of record. See /artifacts/embedding-job.md.

source_refs.description: Sealed source artifacts embedded — primary is Knowledge, optional is GraphUpdate.

profile_id.description: Identifier of the authorized embedding profile (model, dimensionality, chunking strategy) used for this job.

chunk_map.description: Deterministic mapping of chunk_id to source_artifact_id and span, with the resulting vector_id.

span.description: Locator within the source content, e.g. a heading.

vector_id.description: Opaque identifier assigned by the vector index subsystem.

status.description: queued is in-flight; succeeded requires a complete chunk_map; partial is an honest, incomplete result; failed means the run did not complete.

invalidations.description: Vectors from a prior job that this job replaces, each with a reason.
